title: BodyRig
description: Head-mounted cameras attached to one full-body model. There is no T_c_h: body joints are already in world space and each camera pose is derived from the head bone every frame.

model.description: Path to the .blend holding the mesh, rig and pose assets.

armature.description: Name of the armature object inside the .blend. Defaults to 'rig'.

hands.description: Hand sides exported to joints_2d.csv, in column order.

head_camera.description: A forward-facing AR-headset camera rigidly attached to the head, turning toward the tracked hands only within max_deviation_deg.

anchor_bone.description: Head bone the camera is rigidly attached to. Defaults to 'ORG-spine.006' (the head bone of a Rigify rig).

rest_position.description: World-space camera position while the body is in its rest pose. Must lie outside the head mesh, in front of the nose tip.

rest_forward.description: World-space direction the camera looks while the body is in its rest pose. Defaults to [0, -1, 0], the direction the body faces.

track_hands.description: Hand sides treated as the subject. With both listed the camera aims at their midpoint, so left, right and two-handed poses are all framed.

track_landmark.description: Landmark within each tracked hand that the camera aims at. Defaults to 'MiddleProximal', the middle knuckle, which centres the palm.

max_deviation_deg.description: How far the gaze may turn from straight ahead to frame the hands. 0 gives a rigidly forward camera; the default 35 matches a comfortable head turn.
